lean.scope: Frozen binary member-list enumeration, uniqueness under member/disjointness premises, exact frontier transport under the concretization premise, first-column filtering and logical count arithmetic. No native SCC extraction or arbitrary lattice theorem.

tla.faultAdmission: All five require TLC exit 12 and the named invariant violation; tool or parse errors cannot pass.
tla.scope: One outstanding reader, repeated source cuts, staging, atomic publication, cancel/drain, backing lifetime and revision admission. Generation is unbounded in Spec; TLC exploration does not prove unbounded safety, liveness or native trace refinement.

controls: three keyed binary reads per prefix

designFindings: A small rectangle descriptor cannot replace logical fact cardinality.
Unique facts require unique member lists and disjoint rectangles, not only correct Set membership.
A view referencing mutable current roots would change after a later merge.
Lawful min joins can retract exact winner tuples, so abstract lattice growth does not imply monotone Set concretization.
Component traversal order differs from legacy engine publication order; retaining or replaying an ordering journal has its own cost.
remainingArchitectureGate: The UF list entrypoint uses the compressed frontier plan, but current engine rows/membership/indexes/results still materialize facts. Full compressed-engine integration, reader trace refinement, ordered observation and measured whole-engine benefits remain required.
